paragraphs.en: “I am not {crazy} ,”says Dr.William Farber, {shortly} after performing acupuncture ( (针灸) ) on a {rabbit} .“I am ahead of my time.”If he seems a little {defensive} , it might be because even some of his {coworkers} {occasionally} {laugh} at his {unusual} methods.But Farber is {certain} he'll have the last laugh.He's one of a small but {growing} number of American veterinarians ( (兽医) ) now practicing“ {holistic} ”medicine—combining traditional Western {treatments} with acupuncture, chiropractic ( (按摩疗法) ) and {herbal} medicine.
paragraphs.cn: “我没 <u> 疯 </u> ，”威廉·法伯医生在给一只 <u> 兔子 </u> 做完针灸治疗后 <u> 不久 </u> 说道，“我只是走在了时代的前沿。”如果他看起来有点儿像是在 <u> 为自己辩解 </u> ，那可能是因为就连他的一些 <u> 同 </u> <u> 事偶尔 </u> 也会 <u> 嘲笑 </u> 他 <u> 不寻常的 </u> 治疗方法。但法伯 <u> 确信 </u> 他会笑到最后。他是美国当下践行“ <u> 整体 </u> ”疗法的兽医群体中的一员，这个群体虽规模尚小却在 <u> 不断壮大 </u> ，主张将传统西医 <u> 疗法 </u> 与针灸、按摩和 <u> 草药 </u> 医学相结合。

paragraphs.en: Farber, a graduate of Colorado State University, started out as a more {conventional} veterinarian.He became interested in alternative treatments 20 years ago when he suffered from {terrible} back pain.He tried muscle-relaxing {drugs} but found little {relief} from the pain.Then he tried acupuncture, an {ancient} Chinese practice, and was amazed that he improved after two or three treatments.This {comprehensive} approach has shown remarkable results in treating various conditions, from {domestic} pets to farm animals like {cattle} and {pigs} .So, after spending a {couple} of years studying the techniques, he began offering them to {sick} pets.
paragraphs.cn: 法伯毕业于科罗拉多州立大学，起初他是一名比较 <u> 传统的 </u> 兽医。20年前，当他饱受 <u> 严重的 </u> 背痛折磨时，开始对替代疗法产生了兴趣。他尝试过舒缓肌肉的 <u> 药物 </u> ，但发现这些药物的 <u> 缓解 </u> 效果甚微。后来，他尝试了 <u> 古老的 </u> 中国针灸疗法，在两三次治疗后，他惊讶地发现病情有所好转。这种 <u> 全面的 </u> 疗法在治疗各种病症方面效果显著，从 <u> 家养 </u> 宠物到 <u> 牛 </u> 、 <u> 猪 </u> 等农场牲畜都能够受益。因此，在花费了 <u> 几 </u> 年时间学习针灸技术之后，他开始为 <u> 生病的 </u> 宠物提供针灸治疗。

paragraphs.en: In a {representative} {clinic} setting, veterinary {surgeons} begin with a thorough {inspection} .Then they might use {needles} for injections ( (注射) ) and give {pills} .Whether treating a {neat} house cat or a {humble} farm {cow} , it's hard to keep the animals calm.However, they tend to be more comfortable with gentle methods like chiropractic.Veterinarians have reported success in treating conditions affecting the {stomach} and other organs.
paragraphs.cn: 在 <u> 典型的诊所 </u> 场景中，兽 <u> 医 </u> 首先会进行彻底的 <u> 检查 </u> 。然后，他们可能会使用 <u> 针头 </u> 进行注射，并给动物喂 <u> 药 </u> 。无论是治疗 <u> 娇小的 </u> 家猫还是 <u> 普通的 </u> 农场 <u> 奶牛 </u> ，要让动物保持安静都并非易事。不过，动物们往往对按摩等温和疗法表现出更好的适应性。据兽医报告，在治疗 <u> 胃部 </u> 和其他器官的病症方面，这类疗法已取得成功。

paragraphs.en: Leigh Tindale's dog Charlie had a serious heart condition.After Charlie had a heart {attack} , Tindale was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber's treatments eased her dog's suffering so much that she was able to keep him {alive} for an additional five months.Sarah Wilson's elderly cat Mittens suffered from severe {joint} problems that made climbing the {stairs} impossible.After six weeks of acupuncture, Mittens could freely move between floors.“She's like a {teenager} again.”Wilson said.A {deer} named Buck developed an {odd} {infection} that regular medicine couldn't cure.The owner turned to the same treatments.Within three weeks, Buck returned to his normal lively self.
paragraphs.cn: 利·廷德尔的爱犬查理患有严重的心脏病。查理心脏病 <u> 发作 </u> 后，廷德尔本已做好让它安乐死的打算，但法伯的治疗极大地缓解了狗狗的痛苦，因而能够让它再多 <u> 活 </u> 五个月。莎拉·威尔逊的老猫米滕斯患有严重的 <u> 关节 </u> 疾病，不能爬 <u> 楼梯 </u> 。经过六周的针灸治疗后，米滕斯就可以在楼层之间自由走动了。威尔逊说：“她又像个 <u> 小年轻 </u> 一样了。”一只名叫巴克的 <u> 鹿 </u> 得了一种 <u> 奇怪的感染症 </u> ，常规药物无法治愈。它的主人求助于同样的治疗方法。不到三周，巴克就恢复了往日的活力。

paragraphs.en: Farber is certain that the holistic approach will grow more popular with time and if the past is any {indication} , he may be right: Since 1982, {membership} in the American Holistic Veterinary Medical Association has grown from 30 to over 700.“Sometimes it surprises me that it works so well,”he says.“I will do anything to help an animal.That's my job.”
paragraphs.cn: 法伯确信，随着时间的推移，整体疗法会越来越受欢迎。如果过去的 <u> 迹象 </u> 能说明问题的话，那他或许就是对的——自1982年以来，美国整体兽医医学协会的 <u> 会员人数 </u> 已从30人增至700多人。他说：“有时候，我很惊讶这种疗法竟然如此有效。只要能够帮助动物，我什么都愿意做。这就是我的工作。” 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
